# apple_game_center_leaderboard_set (Resource)

Creates a Game Center leaderboard set, which groups leaderboards of an app or of a group of apps. Add leaderboards with `apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_member`, its name with `apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_localization` and its image with `apple_game_center_leaderboard_set_image`, then submit it with `apple_submit_game_center_leaderboard_set`. Destroying the resource deletes the set; one that has been live can't be deleted and stays in App Store Connect. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard_set" "seasons" {
  game_center_detail_id = apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  reference_name        = "Seasons"
  vendor_identifier     = "com.example.seasons"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference_name` (String) Name of the set in App Store Connect.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier of the set, e.g. `com.example.seasons`. Changing it creates a new set.

### Optional

- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center detail, e.g. `apple_game_center_detail.example.id`. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group, for a set its apps share. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center leaderboard set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_leaderboard_set.seasons
  identity = {
    id = "6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center leaderboard set.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard_set.seasons 6b8d0f2a-4c1e-4a3b-8d5f-9e0a1b2c3d4f
```
